name: English
style: Natural, warm spoken English. Short sentences, contractions, everyday acknowledgements ("sure", "of course", "got it"), the way a friendly front-desk person talks.

strings.fallback: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble right now. Could you say that again, or would you like me to connect you to the front desk?
strings.no_transfer: I'm sorry, I can't connect you right now. Can I take a message for the front desk?
strings.billing: Billing and refunds are handled by our front desk team. Let me connect you right away.
strings.frustrated: I'm really sorry about the trouble. Let me connect you to someone at our front desk right away.
strings.unsure_claim: Let me just double-check that with you first. Could you confirm the details once more?
strings.unsure_times: Let me make sure I give you the right time. Which day would suit you?
strings.emergency: This sounds like an emergency. I am transferring you to an emergency care coordinator immediately. If you are in immediate danger, please dial emergency services right now.
